entities.name: Acidic endochitinase SE2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Beta vulgaris UniProt P36910; 293 aa precursor with an N-terminal signal peptide at residues 1–25.
Belongs to glycoside hydrolase family 18 (Glyco_hydro_18/PF00704); catalytic proton donor is annotated at mature-protein position 151.
Secreted/extracellular plant defense enzyme; exact sequence annotation supports the function.
EC 3.2.1.14 endochitinase activity; also reported to hydrolyze chito-oligosaccharides including chitobiose.

entities.name: Chitin endo-hydrolysis
observations: Random endo-hydrolysis of beta-(1→4) linkages in chitin and chitodextrins, yielding shorter N-acetyl-D-glucosamine oligosaccharides.
Reaction corresponds to EC 3.2.1.14 endochitinase activity; substrate specificity beyond chitin/chitodextrins should not be overinterpreted.
